title: 撞门拍桌
summary: Interior of a bright modern property office at midday. EXACTLY THREE PEOPLE are present throughout and the number never changes: a young female cleaner in a navy housekeeping uniform standing still on the near side of a dark wooden desk, a middle-aged male property manager in a white shirt and charcoal waistcoat who strides two paces and slams his palm on the desk, and a young female colleague in a light-grey cleaning uniform standing motionless against the far LEFT corner wall. The left-hand door stays closed and the doorway stays empty — no one enters, no one leaves, no one is duplicated. Venetian-blind light bands fall across the room.
shots:
[Shot 1] Static Shot, medium two-shot: 钱经理 (S3) strides two paces in from the near end of the room, 小唐 (S4) one pace behind him, and he slams his palm flat on the long wooden desk; the grey metal filing cabinets fill the wall behind him, and the desk edge jumps under his hand.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.250, Camera: Push In with small amplitude at fast speed, pushing in on the flat of his palm where it lands on the varnished wood, the desk grain and his knuckle ring coming into focus; his mouth opens and he speaks in a loud bullying nasal Mandarin: [Chinese] 三楼包厢。贵客丢了一只金耳钉。三万八。

[Shot 3] At 00:02.500, Camera: Truck Right with medium amplitude at fast speed, sliding sideways across the desk to a reverse single on 苏小满 (S1); her back is to the camera and a band of blind-light bars the wall behind her, and she does not move her feet.

[Shot 4] At 00:03.750, Camera: Tracking Shot with medium amplitude at fast speed, tracking along the near edge of the desk as 苏小满 (S1) sets both hands flat on the wood and slides the folder she was carrying onto it; the folder's corner stops short of 钱经理 (S3)'s palm.

[Shot 5] At 00:05.000, Camera: Arc Shot with medium amplitude at fast speed, arcing around the far end of the desk as 钱经理 (S3) draws his hand back off the wood and his shoulders square up; the arc carries the blind-light band across his chest.

[Shot 6] At 00:06.500, Camera: Pull Out with large amplitude at slow speed, pulling out to reveal the whole office: the folder lying flat at the middle of the desk, 钱经理 (S3) bearing down across from 苏小满 (S1), 小唐 (S4) standing clear of the desk end in the bright doorway light from the blinds, everyone holding their positions.

From [Shot 3] through [Shot 6] the only mouth movement in frame is the one line 钱经理 (S3) has already delivered in [Shot 2]; the office falls into room tone.

No slow-motion, no soft dissolves, no fades, no unnecessary transitions; use hard cuts only and no on-screen text, letters, logos, subtitles, or watermarks.
soundscape: A clock ticking on the wall and the low hum of the ceiling lights throughout; one sharp heel strike at 0.3s as 钱经理 strides in; a flat palm slap on the desk top at 1.3s; the scrape of a folder sliding across wood at 4.0s; room tone returns at 7.0s.
music: A low sustained string drone enters at 0s, a single wood-block knock lands with the palm slap at 1.3s, and the track thins to one held note from 5.0s onward.
anchor: The whole clip takes place in one small private office and the camera never leaves it. The room has four plain white walls, a grey metal filing cabinet along the far wall, a long wooden desk standing across the middle of the floor, venetian blinds on the right-hand wall laying bright bands across the desk top, and a closed wooden door set flat into the back wall. The walls behind the people are smooth painted plaster of one single light colour, unbroken from the skirting board up to the ceiling. All cardboard boxes and folders are plain brown corrugated cardboard. The people named in this beat are the only people in it: the manager stays behind the desk on the far side, the cleaner stays at the near end of it with her back to the camera, and the colleague stands where this beat places her. The count does not change.

summary: The manager narrows it down to one person, staring across the desk; she denies it flatly and without heat.
shots:
[Shot 1] Static Shot, medium two-shot across the desk: 钱经理 (S3) on the far side with the filing cabinets behind his back, one palm flat on the wood; 苏小满 (S1) at the near end with her back to the camera; 小唐 (S4) against the back wall at the far left of frame, waiting.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.250, Camera: Push In with small amplitude at fast speed, pushing in on 钱经理 (S3) as he straightens up slowly, tucks both hands behind his back and tips his head to one side, fixing 苏小满 (S1) with the look of a man who has already decided; his collar catches the blind-light. His mouth opens and he speaks in a flat accusing Mandarin: [Chinese] 收台的时候，就你一个人在。

[Shot 3] At 00:02.500, Camera: Truck Right with medium amplitude at fast speed, sliding sideways across the desk to a reverse single on 苏小满 (S1), the blind-laying light barring the wall behind her; her apron strap lifts slightly at the waist. She does not move her feet and does not look away, and she answers at once in a low steady Mandarin: [Chinese] 不是我。

[Shot 4] At 00:03.750, Camera: Tracking Shot with medium amplitude at fast speed, tracking left along the desk as 钱经理 (S3) finishes the accusation and stops, and his eyes leave her; he turns his head and shoulders toward the left-hand wall. 苏小满 (S1) stays where she is, her eyes following his turn.

[Shot 5] At 00:05.000, Camera: Arc Shot with medium amplitude at fast speed, arcing around the end of the desk onto 钱经理 (S3)'s face as he turns his head fully left and looks straight at 小唐 (S4) against the wall; the look lasts a beat and says everything.

[Shot 6] At 00:06.500, Camera: Pull Out with large amplitude at slow speed, pulling out to reveal the whole office as 小唐 (S4) pushes off the wall with her shoulder and takes the first step forward, and 钱经理 (S3) gives one short jerk of his chin toward the open floor beside the desk; 苏小满 (S1) has gone very still, watching the colleague approach.

From [Shot 4] through [Shot 6] the only mouth movement in frame is 钱经理 (S3) swallowing; every line of dialogue has already finished, and the office falls into room tone.

No slow-motion, no soft dissolves, no fades, no unnecessary transitions; use hard cuts only and no on-screen text, letters, logos, subtitles, or watermarks.
soundscape: A clock ticking on the wall and the low hum of the ceiling lights throughout; a short inhale from 钱经理 at 1.1s before he speaks; one nervous swallow from 小唐 at 5.2s; the soft scrape of a shoe on the floor at 6.8s as she steps forward.
music: A low sustained string drone begins at 0s, a single muted cello note enters at 1.3s when he starts speaking, and the track thins to a single held note from 5.0s.

title: 小唐作证
summary: Pressed from the wall, the young colleague gives a deliberately vague testimony, and the manager takes it as proof.
shots:
[Shot 1] Static Shot, medium three-shot: 钱经理 (S3) behind the desk facing the camera, one palm flat on the wood; 小唐 (S4) on the open floor beside the desk, a pace in from its near end, her hands folded low; 苏小满 (S1) at the near end of that desk with her back to the camera.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.250, Camera: Push In with small amplitude at fast speed, pushing in on 钱经理 (S3)'s face as he finishes looking at 小唐 (S4) and turns his eyes to her face, waiting; he lifts one hand off the desk and turns it over, palm up, a short beckoning motion, and the desk's blind-light band slides across his knuckles. His mouth stays shut through it.

[Shot 3] At 00:02.500, Camera: Truck Left with medium amplitude at fast speed, sliding sideways to a closer single on 小唐 (S4) standing on the open floor: she draws her shoulders up, keeps her eyes on the floor tiles and lets them flick once toward 苏小满 (S1), then away; her hands tighten on each other at her waist. She speaks in a small thin nervous Mandarin: [Chinese] 钱经理。中午，我看见她往兜里塞东西。没看清。

[Shot 4] At 00:03.750, Camera: Tracking Shot with medium amplitude at fast speed, tracking from 小唐 (S4) toward 苏小满 (S1), showing the distance between the two of them across the open floor; a band of blind-light lies between their feet.

[Shot 5] At 00:05.000, Camera: Arc Shot with medium amplitude at fast speed, arcing onto 苏小满 (S1)'s face as she turns her head a few degrees toward 小唐 (S4) and holds there, her jaw setting, the loose hair at her temple settling against her cheek.

[Shot 6] At 00:06.500, Camera: Pull Out with large amplitude at slow speed, pulling out to reveal all three of them in the office: the manager behind the desk, the colleague on the open floor with her hands still clasped, the cleaner at the near end of the desk with her back turned. All three hold their positions.

From [Shot 4] through [Shot 6] the only mouth movement in frame is 小唐 (S4) finishing the one line she has already delivered; the office falls into room tone.

title: 看清楚了再说

shots:
